albert_marko_: Day 10: Walter "Bones" Marko reached U-F13 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Walter "Bones" Marko fired, and Hugo Flex was grazed. A letter from home reached Walter "Bones" Marko before dusk. Walter "Bones" Marko read it twice and slept a little easier. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Walter "Bones" Marko did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Walter "Bones" Marko saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at U-F13 and fired once. Viktor Blacksmithsb was grazed. A letter from home reached Walter "Bones" Marko before dusk. Walter "Bones" Marko read it twice and slept a little easier.

On a quiet night Walter "Bones" Marko (Hegemony) and Walter "Button" Jmw (Concord) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there. A letter from home reached Walter "Bones" Marko before dusk. Walter "Bones" Marko read it twice and slept a little easier.

Walter "Bones" Marko spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at U-F13 is closed now. A letter from home reached Walter "Bones" Marko before dusk. Walter "Bones" Marko read it twice and slept a little easier.

Walter "Bones" Marko let three easy targets go by. The fourth was the one worth the risk. Marek "Saint" Flex was badly wounded. A letter from home reached Walter "Bones" Marko before dusk. Walter "Bones" Marko read it twice and slept a little easier.
ayangd: Day 9: Hugo "Lucky" Ayangd reached R-R5 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Hugo "Lucky" Ayangd was hit in the forearm at R-R5. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney of the Concord (@qhmullaney). The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Hugo "Lucky" Ayangd helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Hugo "Lucky" Ayangd rejoined the squad at R-R5. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Hugo "Lucky" Ayangd wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Hugo "Lucky" Ayangd found an old map of the Ossuary Wood from before the war. There was a school on it, and an orchard. He looked for them. He did not find them.
Hugo "Lucky" Ayangd tried to remember the price of a loaf in Halden. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.
Hugo "Lucky" Ayangd mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted.
A loose thread in Hugo "Lucky" Ayangd's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.
cantthink_ofsmth: On Day 9, Cyril Ofsmth arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Cyril Ofsmth watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Cyril Ofsmth moved to a new hide at S-C8 before dawn, because the old one had been too lucky. The first shot from the new one found Silas Heffy, badly wounded. Two shots, one miss. The second found Valentin Broccoli, gravely wounded. Cyril Ofsmth cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. Cyril Ofsmth got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 751. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill has been won. Cyril Ofsmth listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Cyril Ofsmth tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Cyril Ofsmth's bunk. He has named it Little Sergeant.
Little Sergeant the rat now waits for Cyril Ofsmth at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations.
Cyril Ofsmth counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Florian Heffy was badly wounded.
cappa_kid: On the way to T-S11, Marek "Lucky" Kid tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

Marek "Lucky" Kid fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Matthias Jawn was grazed, and that rifle did not fire again tonight. The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Marek "Lucky" Kid looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Marek "Lucky" Kid in the open at T-S11. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Zeno Pickapic of the Hegemony (@pickapic0325). The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Marek "Lucky" Kid waited for that to change. When it did, Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers was grazed. Marek "Lucky" Kid has a bed in the hospital dugout at last, between a man who prays and a man who swears. He says it is a fair balance. Marek "Lucky" Kid ate a whole bowl of soup today. The surgeon says that is better than any medicine. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Marek "Lucky" Kid stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Another quiet day in the ward for Marek "Lucky" Kid. He counted the cracks in the ceiling and got to forty-one.
Nobody could reach Marek "Lucky" Kid in time. He died on a stretcher by the aid post wall, one of too many waiting.
Another member of the House of Kid reached the line: Severin "Mud" Kid. He asked where Marek "Lucky" Kid had slept, then chose a different corner.
Severin "Mud" Kid measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
A bullet hit Severin "Mud" Kid's belt buckle at T-S11 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Zeno Pickapic of the Hegemony (@pickapic0325).
don_foolio_1: Severin Foolio told the sergeant he was a tailor. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Severin Foolio watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Severin Foolio fished it out by feel and then had to wash again. Mail came up the line with a letter for Severin Foolio. Severin Foolio read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A supply man offered Severin Foolio a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records. Mail came up the line with a letter for Severin Foolio. Severin Foolio read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Rumour reached N-F8 that the war would be over by spring. Severin Foolio has heard it before. So has everyone. Mail came up the line with a letter for Severin Foolio. Severin Foolio read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Severin Foolio waited for that to change. When it did, Matthias "Smokes" Bigmanreen was badly wounded.
eccentricredeye: The quartermaster asked Henrik Eccentricred to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
The Concord flag went up over Verdel Ridge. Henrik Eccentricred did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Henrik Eccentricred in the open at S-F16. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Edmund Potato of the Hegemony (@boiled_potato31). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Henrik Eccentricred fell at S-F16 and never moved again. Shot by Edmund Potato of the Hegemony (@boiled_potato31).
Bram Eccentricred joined S-F16 under the shadow of Henrik Eccentricred's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
Bram Eccentricred was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.

Bram Eccentricred found a shirt button in the bread. He ate around it and kept the button. Both were useful. Day 6. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Bram Eccentricred watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Bram Eccentricred heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F16 and grazed Bram Eccentricred's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Dietrich Thky of the Hegemony (@haydnburrell_9thky).
The medic looked at Bram Eccentricred's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to S-F16. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Someone in S-F16 asked Bram Eccentricred about Tannenfeld. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted.

A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at S-F16. Bram Eccentricred was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Henrik "Lucky" Carterdelaru of the Hegemony (@carterdelaruelle).
The papers say Isidor Eccentricred. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Bram Eccentricred's eyes. Nobody in S-F16 argues.

Isidor Eccentricred spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Isidor Eccentricred answered to number 130. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Isidor Eccentricred stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Isidor Eccentricred reached up to fix a sandbag at S-F16 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Dietrich "Spark" Geddy of the Hegemony (@geddy__97).
Isidor Eccentricred rejoined the squad at S-F16. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
Isidor Eccentricred lent Albin "Tin" Krut a razor. It came back sharper, with a new handle carved from an old tent peg.
Isidor Eccentricred found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
ericccc_o: The sergeant gave Quentin Ericccc a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 11 or any other.

Yann "Spark" Bennyliebs (Concord) and Quentin Ericccc (Hegemony) were sent out to cut the other side's wire at Calvary Farm on the same night. They met in the middle and agreed to go home. A letter from home found Quentin Ericccc before the night shift. Quentin Ericccc folded it small and kept it close.
The men argued about whether fish sleep. Quentin Ericccc said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know.

Quentin Ericccc kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it. A letter from home found Quentin Ericccc before the night shift. Quentin Ericccc folded it small and kept it close.
Quentin Ericccc accepted promotion to Lance Corporal. Later, he practised giving the morning orders quietly enough not to wake the dugout.
horror0756: Isidor "Hollow" Horror reported to S-S5 with a lock of hair in a matchbox sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Isidor "Hollow" Horror ended a letter with 'nothing to report', then added half a page about the missing soap.
A patient apologized for bleeding on Isidor "Hollow" Horror's sleeve. He told the patient to concentrate on staying awake.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-S5 with the rations. Isidor "Hollow" Horror ate while listening to the revised orders.

A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Isidor "Hollow" Horror's bunk. He has named it Duchess. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Isidor "Hollow" Horror is number 484. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Isidor "Hollow" Horror read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Isidor "Hollow" Horror kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.
Isidor "Hollow" Horror gave Karel Slow the last match in the trench. Karel used it to light a candle so that Hollow could finish a letter.
Duchess the rat now waits for Isidor "Hollow" Horror at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations.
Duchess ran squealing out of the dugout at three in the morning. Isidor "Hollow" Horror followed, cursing, seconds before a shell came through the roof. He owes Duchess his life.
joha123477: Leopold "Saint" Joha signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-F4 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word. After what happened at the Hanging Bridge, Leopold "Saint" Joha asked to serve as a sniper. Nobody argued.

Leopold "Saint" Joha took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for. Mail came up the line with a letter for Leopold "Saint" Joha. Leopold "Saint" Joha read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Someone asked Leopold "Saint" Joha to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten. Day 6. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Leopold "Saint" Joha watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Machine-gun fire swept R-F4. Leopold "Saint" Joha took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Wendel Jesus of the Hegemony (@jesus.gr9). Leopold "Saint" Joha looked over the parapet at R-F4 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Wendel Jesus of the Hegemony (@jesus.gr9).

The papers connected Ivo Joha to Leopold "Saint" Joha. The men took longer to learn Ivo Joha's own habits, but they made the effort. The transfer made Ivo Joha a sniper. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Henrik Hunted and Ivo Joha divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ivo Joha. Ivo Joha read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Ivo Joha aimed a step ahead and fired: Clement Snake, grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ivo Joha. Ivo Joha read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Ivo Joha was hit in the hip at R-F4. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Jonas Solyommadar of the Hegemony (@solyommadar11). A single shot at R-F4. Ivo Joha sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Jonas Solyommadar of the Hegemony (@solyommadar11).
A letter came with Silas Joha: "I am Ivo Joha's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Silas Joha was hit hard in the fight at R-F4 before anyone could fire. The raider was Arno "Doc" As of the Hegemony. Raider: Arno "Doc" As of the Hegemony (@a.s26221). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Silas Joha stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Silas Joha was carrying water up to R-F4 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Silas Joha did not. Shot by Tobias Flyer of the Hegemony (@caboose_flyer1280102938392). Silas Joha was killed outright at R-F4, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Tobias Flyer of the Hegemony (@caboose_flyer1280102938392).

Zeno "Button" Joha joined R-F4 under the shadow of Silas Joha's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Zeno "Button" Joha answered to number 246. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-F4. Zeno "Button" Joha has learned to walk bent double.
A clear shot from R-F4. Zeno "Button" Joha gravely wounded Clement Snake and slid back down below the parapet.
Zeno "Button" Joha and Henrik Hunted found a cat in the ruins at Grey Mill and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Henrik.
Zeno "Button" Joha wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
A bullet grazed Zeno "Button" Joha's ribs at R-F4. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Ivo "Rabbit" Beck of the Hegemony (@brandon_marc_beck).
katdog1234657: Quentin Katdog told the sergeant he was a bookbinder. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry. Now serving as a runner, Quentin Katdog discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

Quentin Katdog pulled Edmund "Hollow" Biwott out of a flooded shell hole at the Ossuary Wood. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember. A letter from home found Quentin Katdog before the night shift. Quentin Katdog folded it small and kept it close.
At the Drowned Farm, Quentin Katdog of the Concord and Benedikt Calderthebal of the Hegemony traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes.
Someone in S-S8 asked Quentin Katdog about Kesselby. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Quentin Katdog fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Quentin Katdog kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

The last report placed Quentin Katdog near Sorrow Copse. By evening, no later report had arrived. Missing. The clerk counted the names twice. Quentin Katdog is number 397 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Quentin Katdog looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Quentin Katdog crawled back into S-S8 at dawn after two nights in a shell hole at the Drowned Farm, covered in mud and carrying a tin of tobacco. He asked if he had missed breakfast.
Quentin Katdog dreamt he was back in Kesselby, working as a bookbinder. He woke up and said nothing all morning.

Quentin Katdog borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. A letter from home found Quentin Katdog before the night shift. Quentin Katdog folded it small and kept it close.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-S8 and grazed Quentin Katdog's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Benedikt "Crow" Hanka of the Hegemony (@hanka_b97).
magtyu_: Teodor "Button" Magtyu introduced himself as a railway porter from Brennmoor. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
Teodor "Button" Magtyu and Marek "Lucky" Chase argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war.
Teodor "Button" Magtyu had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any.

A round went through the rim of Teodor "Button" Magtyu's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Benedikt Ngaihte of the Hegemony (@mng.ngaihte). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Teodor "Button" Magtyu kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Teodor "Button" Magtyu came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon. The clerk counted the names twice. Teodor "Button" Magtyu is number 497 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-S5 with the rations. Teodor "Button" Magtyu ate while listening to the revised orders.
Teodor "Button" Magtyu wrote to five brothers, all on other fronts. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.

Machine-gun fire swept R-S5. Teodor "Button" Magtyu took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Dorian Heitoralmeid of the Hegemony (@heitoralmeida314).
The bearers moved Teodor "Button" Magtyu's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule.
Teodor "Button" Magtyu never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.
michael_lee6767: Isidor Lee reported to N-F3 with a bullet that missed him sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
n.scotti75: In Greyhallow, Nils Scotti was a railway porter. In S-C2, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a railway porter again.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Nils Scotti wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

The mud froze hard overnight. For one morning Nils Scotti could walk on top of it, like a man walking on water. The clerk counted the names twice. Nils Scotti is number 749 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Nils Scotti wrote to a landlady who kept his room exactly as it was that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Nils Scotti tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
Hugo Thegreat fixed the strap on Nils Scotti's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Nils Scotti put a flat stone under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.
Nils Scotti carried three men out of S-C2 on a stretcher. One of them thanked him. Two could not.
peterpoppinga2: By the time Florian "Bones" Peterpopping reached U-F8, the war was 10 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

Florian "Bones" Peterpopping found a flower growing out of a sandbag. He did not tell anyone. He checks on it every morning. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into U-F8. Florian "Bones" Peterpopping has learned to walk bent double.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Florian "Bones" Peterpopping across the shin at U-F8. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Bastian Deltascourge of the Hegemony (@deltascourge1).
Florian "Bones" Peterpopping no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.

Florian "Bones" Peterpopping had just lit a cigarette at U-F8 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Bram Eliyork of the Hegemony (@eliyork13).
Florian "Bones" Peterpopping is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
scarentear: Gustav "Brick" Scarentear signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at Q-S7 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Gustav "Brick" Scarentear looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

On a quiet night Severin Stry (Hegemony) and Gustav "Brick" Scarentear (Concord) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached Q-S7 with the rations. Gustav "Brick" Scarentear ate while listening to the revised orders.
Gustav "Brick" Scarentear polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.
The telephone wire to Q-S7 was cut by shelling four times. Gustav "Brick" Scarentear crawled out and spliced it four times.
A bullet clipped Gustav "Brick" Scarentear's helmet at Q-S7 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Felix Nickloser of the Hegemony (@nickloser).
Gustav "Brick" Scarentear walked back up the communication trench to Q-S7, slower than before, but on his own feet.
wolfmecher8181: Jakub Wolfmecher came up on Day 9 carrying news from Oakmere. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Jakub Wolfmecher had just lit a cigarette at R-R15 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Severin Vazintian of the Hegemony (@vazintian). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Jakub Wolfmecher kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

A bullet hit Jakub Wolfmecher in the neck at R-R15. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Quentin Souptime of the Hegemony (@souptime13). Jakub Wolfmecher was carried into the hospital dugout feet first, because that was the only way the stretcher fit through the door. Jakub Wolfmecher recognized the orderly today and said the orderly's name out loud. The surgeon says he will pull through. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Jakub Wolfmecher is number 952. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Jakub Wolfmecher read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Someone moved Jakub Wolfmecher's stretcher out of the doorway. It was the most anyone did for him all day, and he was grateful.
Jakub Wolfmecher held on as long as he could on the stretcher outside the aid post. There were not enough hands, and not enough beds.
Arno Wolfmecher asked about Jakub Wolfmecher on arriving at R-R15. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
Arno Wolfmecher and Silas Tadzyman cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.
Arno Wolfmecher has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Casimir "Spark" Dominickg, grazed.
xakhariash: Bastian Xakhariash arrived on Day 14 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Albin Rjk held the mirror while Bastian Xakhariash shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.
xplod1n: Oskar Xplod was a tailor in Brennmoor until the posters went up. He came to T-F13 with a pressed cornflower, and within a day the whole squad knew that he hates silence more than shelling.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Oskar Xplod wrote to a younger sister who sends drawings that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Oskar Xplod helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else. Grey Mill is lost. Oskar Xplod heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Oskar Xplod got a letter from Rosa. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.
Oskar Xplod fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Norbert "Ghost" Thembamstel was grazed. Oskar Xplod ate breakfast without a word.
The shelling stopped while Oskar Xplod was counting the seconds between hits. He kept counting anyway, and waited a long time before moving.
Fresh from training, Oskar Xplod still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Valentin "Ghost" Scotty, grazed.
zach.thompson_74: Viktor Thompson found a place in R-R7 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Viktor Thompson looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

An enemy patrol scattered in front of R-R7. Viktor Thompson fired at the last man to run. Hugo Kazyutheaval was grazed. A bullet clipped Viktor Thompson's helmet at R-R7 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Anselm "Owl" Shadowizard of the Hegemony (@shadowizard__). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Viktor Thompson is number 864. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Viktor Thompson stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Viktor Thompson came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
A clear shot from R-R7. Viktor Thompson grazed Yann "Smokes" Tylen and slid back down below the parapet.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Viktor Thompson across the shin at R-R7. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Casimir "Saint" Bevis of the Hegemony (@bevis.44).

A bullet struck Viktor Thompson below the ribs at R-R7. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Konrad Izu of the Hegemony (@arch_izu). Viktor Thompson was hit at R-R7 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Konrad Izu of the Hegemony (@arch_izu).
The House of Thompson sent Ivo "Mud" Thompson after Viktor Thompson. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
